description: Use this when someone asks for the "property tax appeal deadline", "when is the last day to appeal my property tax assessment", or where and how to file a property tax appeal. Works for any US address or county. Give a street address, or a county and state. Returns the exact deadline date with days left, the board or office that hears the appeal, the filing method, form and steps, and source links. Where a county sets deadlines per township or town (for example in Illinois, New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts and Michigan), a street address returns the date for that parcel's township or town. Where the deadline runs from the date on the assessment notice (for example in Texas, Florida, Georgia and Washington), it returns the rule and computes the exact day when given the notice date. Can take up to about 25 seconds for counties that need the live search. Do not use for exemption applications (use find_property_tax_exemptions). Read-only.

address.description: Street address with city and state. Optional if county and state are given. Needed to resolve a township or town.

county.description: County name, for example "Cook County". Optional if an address is given.

noticeDate.description: Mailing date printed on the assessment notice, as YYYY-MM-DD, for places where the deadline runs from the notice date.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, for example "IL".

name: get_property_tax_appeal_deadline
title: Property tax appeal deadline and where to file
